title: Can I SURVIVE MORE Drawback Chess?
summary: Drawback Chess vs online humans (2+1); goal 5 wins. Drawbacks seen: Pawn Battle, Quit Horsing Around, Lame Duck, True Gentleman, Stop Stalling, Fixation, Rook Fan Club. Win by capturing the king.
rules: Standard setup and moves; each player is dealt one secret random drawback (card with Easy-Hard difficulty slider); the opponent's drawback is revealed when the game ends ('Your opponent's drawback was ...').
No check/checkmate: kings may move into or stay in attack; capturing the enemy king wins.
Breaking or failing your drawback condition makes you lose (or the move is simply illegal, depending on drawback wording).
Players may chat/rename to bluff or reveal drawbacks.

Drawbacks in this video: Pawn Battle - you lose if you have fewer pawns than your opponent. Quit Horsing Around - if you moved a knight last move, you can't move a knight. Lame Duck - can't move your king. True Gentleman - can't capture queens. Stop Stalling - your pieces can't move laterally (sideways). Fixation - you must keep moving the same pawn / non-pawn piece (text partially visible). Rook Fan Club - you must promote to rooks; your king and queen cannot move diagonally.
win_condition: Capture the enemy king. Goal: 5 wins.

opponent.name: Online humans ('lazy grey zebra', 'lazy red giraffe', 'sleepy black monkey')
